crimson-blueguard-crimson-redguard-behav.description: Turns Haven City's Crimson Guard blue. The mod adds a blue-recolored Crimson Guard as its own standalone entity — a new GOAL type, `crimson-blue-guard`, that is a subtype of the stock `crimson-guard`. While the mod is enabled it guard bikes and hellcats. Turn it off and the city goes back to 100% red. The blue guards are **not** a new faction and **not** a new AI. They behave exactly like the red ones — they react to your crimes, raise the wanted level, chase you, shoot, try to arrest you and change weapons as the alert escalates — because they inherit every one of those code paths untouched. The only gameplay addition is that some of them carry a grenade launcher.
